content_zh:
但是围堵她的人就不一样了，尤其是打头的那个名叫霍思雨的女生，她眯了眼，看向博九的目光里充满了厌恶：“上次我就警告过你，让你离秦少远一点，原本以为你还会乖乖听话，没想到你还是学不会什么叫做教训？连这个食堂你都敢来，是还想被水淋吗？”
她对这个暴发户不满很久了，一想到有他这样的人惦记着她喜欢的男神，她就觉得反胃！
“把他给我拽到厕所里去！我今天就让他清楚清楚，什么地方该来，什么地方不该来。”
霍思雨的厉害在学校里是出了名的，对待不喜欢的人，她通常情况下都会用这样的手段，整的人有苦难言。
听说还会被人的头按进马桶里。
这一下，博九要倒霉了！
唉，刚从医院出来就又要进去，也怪可怜的。
就在人们这样想的时候。
只见博九单手抄着裤袋，一个抬腿就把霍思雨踹在了地上！
那动作又快又狠，几乎让人看不清她是怎么做到的。
霍思雨倒下的时候，五张六腑都是疼的，像是不敢置信，又像是怒到了极点：“你，你这个变态，居然敢踹我！“
被这样骂着的博九却不慌不忙的着裤袋，薄唇微勾：“你以前怎么对我的，现在全部都还给你。”
哗啦啦！
随着博九的声音落下。
一瓶矿泉水全部都淋到了霍思雨的头上！
霍思雨先是一愣，接着整个人都如同疯了一般：“博九！你给我等着！你以为你这么肖想校草，他会放过你吗？全校的人都恶心你恶心到吐了，他只不过是觉得厌恶，不想对你出手！”
闻言，博九轻轻的笑了起来，半弯着腰，伸出手一只手来轻轻的拍了拍霍思雨的脸，那样子非常的帅气：“多大点事，妹子，听好了，我随时都有时间虐你。”
“你！“霍思雨又想撕人了！
“嘘。“博九用食指压了压自己淡色的唇：”我这个人脾气不好，别总是逼我动手揍人，还有，就算我喜欢男人，也不会喜欢上你口中那位秦少，他想来，我也随时奉陪。“
扔下这么一句如同炸弹般的话话，博九就像个没事人一样的出了食堂。

怎么说呢，吵吵闹闹的地方，基本上她都不想多呆。
在她离开后，食堂二楼，视野最好，却不是谁都能去的地方，分别出现了两道修长的人影。
其中一道趴在栏杆上，朝着身后阴影处的修长人影抬了抬下巴，意味深长的道：“刚开学还追着你背影说非你不嫁的人，现在却说就算他喜欢男人，也不会喜欢上你。请问秦大少爷，你现在是什么感觉？”
被点名的人身姿挺拔，容颜俊美，正斜靠着偌大的落地玻璃窗，交叠着修长的双腿，低头看着拿在手上的书本，在他的身后是整个学校的风景，熠熠生辉的光耀。
闻言，他并没有说话，只是抬起眸来，朝着博九离开的方向看了一眼…
喜欢国民校草是女生请大家
content_en:
But the people who surrounded her were different, especially the girl named Huo Siyu who was leading the way. She narrowed her eyes and looked at Bo Jiu with disgust: "I warned you last time to stay away from Mr. Qin. I thought you would still be obedient, but I didn't expect that you still can't learn what a lesson is? You dare to come to this cafeteria, do you still want to get wet?"
She has been dissatisfied with this upstart for a long time. The thought of someone like him thinking about the male god she likes makes her feel sick to her stomach!
"Drag him to the toilet! I will make it clear to him today where he should come and where he should not come."
Huo Siyu is well-known in school for her power. She usually uses this method to treat people she doesn't like, which makes people miserable.
I heard that someone's head would be pushed into the toilet.
Now, Bo Jiu is in trouble!
Alas, it is pitiful to have to go in again just after coming out of the hospital.
Just when people think so.
I saw Bo Jiu holding his trouser pocket with one hand, and he kicked Huo Siyu to the ground with just one lift of his leg!
The movement was so fast and cruel that it was almost impossible to see how she did it.
When Huo Siyu fell down, his whole body ached, as if he couldn't believe it, but also as if he was extremely angry: "You, you pervert, dare to kick me!"
Being scolded like this, Bo Jiu calmly opened his trouser pockets and slightly hooked his thin lips: "Whatever you did to me before, now I will give it all back to you."
Wow!
As Bo Jiu's voice fell.
A bottle of mineral water was poured on Huo Siyu's head!
Huo Siyu was stunned at first, and then he seemed to be going crazy: "Bo Jiu! Just wait! Do you think he will let you go if you miss the school girl so much? Everyone in the school is disgusted by you. You are so sick that you vomited. He just feels disgusted and doesn't want to attack you!"
Hearing this, Bo Jiu laughed softly, half-bent, stretched out his hand and patted Huo Siyu's face gently with one hand. He looked very handsome like that: "What a big deal, sister, listen up, I have time to torture you at any time."
"You!" Huo Siyu wants to tear someone up again!
"Shhh." Bo Jiu pressed his pale lips with his index finger: "I have a bad temper. Don't always force me to beat people up. Also, even if I like men, I won't like that Young Master Qin you mentioned. If he wants to come, I will always accompany him."
After dropping such a bomb-like sentence, Bojiu walked out of the cafeteria like a normal person.
How should I put it, basically she didn't want to stay in a noisy place.
After she left, two slender figures appeared on the second floor of the cafeteria, a place with the best view but not everyone could go.
One of them was lying on the railing, raised his chin towards the slender figure in the shadow behind him, and said meaningfully: "The man who chased your back when school started and said he would not marry unless you, now says that even if he likes men, he will not like you. May I ask, Mr. Qin, how do you feel now?"
The person named was tall and straight, with a handsome face. He was leaning against the large floor-to-ceiling glass window, with his slender legs crossed, looking down at the book in his hand. Behind him was the scenery of the entire school, shining with brilliance.
Hearing this, he did not speak, but just raised his eyes and glanced in the direction Bo Jiu left...
If you like the national school girl, please be a girl.
